Keeps only the fields you name on each item and drops the rest, so outputs and messages stay short.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `transform.pick` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Fields (`fields`) | list of text | yes |  | One per line, e.g. question and spread. Paths like outcomes.0.price work too. |

## Items

The items it receives, with only the fields **Fields** (`fields`) names.
